The service journal yielded text for the selected Santa Ana run. Firecrawl returned only the watermark text for the Wigodsky scan, so the original publisher PDF was checked directly. The ERAU scan was compared by digest with the previously archived FAA PDF.

records.title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records, F044 AF SG M
records.note: The 2003 amendment describes an indefinite retention policy for the original AF Form 361 at USAFSAM/FEH at the then Brooks City-Base and three years at individual aerospace physiology training units. The notice is public. Current records holdings and any releasable de-identified extract remain unverified.
